headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended gains as markets look ahead to the new trading week

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: FPIs turned net buyers in the final week of October despite overall equity outflows during the month.
Strong buying in heavyweights like Reliance and Adani Ports lifted benchmark indices in recent sessions.
October GST mop-up surged 23% to over ₹2.31 lakh crore, indicating strong underlying economic activity.
Solid Q2 earnings from major oil marketing companies boosted investor confidence.
whatHappening: IOC, BPCL, and HPCL recorded Q2 profits of ₹30,106 crore, reaching nearly 39% of last year's total annual earnings.
Hyundai Motor reported its highest-ever sales for October, driven primarily by strong performance in exports.
Average daily transaction value on UPI crossed ₹1 trillion during October.
Nifty and Sensex rallied up to 2% last week as markets rebound from recent losses.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices rebounded in recent trading sessions with Nifty and Sensex gaining up to 2% over the week.
Robust Q2 earnings from oil marketing companies, strong GST collections, and a surge in Hyundai's October sales provided market support.
With the market closed for the weekend, investors are eyeing foreign capital flows and global cues as trading resumes on Monday.
